title: Krabi vs Koh Lanta: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Lanta wins for beach relaxation; Krabi wins for variety and adventure. Both are southern Thailand classics but serve different traveler types.

faq.q: Is Krabi or Koh Lanta better for couples?
faq.a: Koh Lanta is the better pick for couples with quiet beaches and romantic sunsets.

faq.q: Which is cheaper, Krabi or Koh Lanta?
faq.a: Koh Lanta is cheaper overall. Budget ฿800—1,200/day vs Krabi ฿1,200—2,800/day.

faq.q: How do you get from Krabi to Koh Lanta?
faq.a: Ferry (2h, ฿350—500) or drive via road bridges (1.5—2h, ฿300—400).

faq.q: When is the best time to visit?
faq.a: Both best Nov—Apr (dry season). Krabi stays accessible during monsoon; Lanta shuts down.

faq.q: Should I split time between Krabi and Koh Lanta?
faq.a: If you have 5+ nights, yes. 2—3 nights Krabi + 3—4 nights Lanta is ideal.

faq.q: What are the best beaches on Koh Lanta?
faq.a: Long Beach, Klong Nin, Kantiang Bay, Klong Khong, Nui Beach — all west-coast with sunset views.

faq.q: Is Railay Beach worth a day trip from Koh Lanta?
faq.a: Yes — ferry to Ao Nang then longtail to Railay. World-class limestone cliffs and beach.

faq.q: Is Krabi or Koh Lanta better for families?
faq.a: Koh Lanta is excellent for families with calm shallow beaches and a safe, quiet atmosphere.
